name: tht-radial-formed
title: Radial through-hole part, formed leads
summary: Radial lead part on two square leads formed out from the pitch at the body to the lead pitch within the standoff, a marking plane on its top (lead_pitch, body_pitch, lead_diameter, lead_below, standoff, root, bend_radius, body_diameter, body_height, top_round).
provenance: Original work: the in-code through-hole builder's construction (crates/solidcraft-integration/src/models/tht.rs, retired with this file) authored through SolidCraft's commands over plain parameters by `cargo test -p sparksmith-solidcraft --test author_parts -- --ignored` (saved at Ø5 × 11 mm, leads 0.5 mm from 2 mm at the body to 5 mm, 1.5 mm standoff); the tht generator gives every value. Estimated lead roots, bends and rounds; no vendor drawing or EDA/CAD library data copied.
